method: Panoramax API (api.panoramax.xyz), bbox + per-year datetime windows (2013-2026), only licences starting with CC (CC BY-SA 4.0 found; etalab-2.0 excluded). Candidates filtered by distance and bearing to building, then viewed as contact sheets by Claude; 360 images cropped with tools/align/panorama_crop.py. Wikimedia Commons: HTTP 429 on 2026-11-22 (one polite request with descriptive User-Agent, not retried). Mapillary: Graph API requires an access token (HTTP 500/code 190 without key), not used.
status_rule: exact_verified requires measured control points and a computed fit with adequate coverage: none reached it. approximate = same building, same side (bearing diff <=60 deg to the artist side estimated from the print), no fit. unverified = building is the same but the artist's side or pose is not established. lost_or_reconstructed = subject destroyed/rebuilt/moved; context only.
artist_bearing_note: artist_bearing_estimate_deg is Claude's reading of the print (bearing from building to artist camera), not a measurement; null where it could not be read.
